description: This file defines the GenericResultWaiter class, which implements a mechanism to wait for and retrieve results or exceptions from asynchronous service calls within the Apache OFBiz framework.

classes.name: GenericResultWaiter
classes.description: A class that implements waiting for service results, handling success, failure, and status reporting.

methods.name: receiveResult
methods.description: Handles successful result reception, updates state, and logs if verbose mode is on.

methods.name: receiveThrowable
methods.description: Handles exceptions thrown during service execution, updates state.

methods.name: status
methods.description: Returns the current status code of the service.

methods.name: isCompleted
methods.description: Checks if the service has completed.

methods.name: getThrowable
methods.description: Returns the exception if any, throws if call not completed.

methods.name: getResult
methods.description: Returns the result map if completed, throws if not.

methods.name: waitForResult
methods.description: Waits for the service to complete with default timeout.

methods.name: waitForResult
methods.description: Waits for the service to complete, checking every specified milliseconds.
